Taylor: Heads-up — Atlas go-live TOM @10:00 PT. Dropping a compact ops runbook for prefill / cache / batch / streaming + a one-line feedback flow. Ping if you want to own any item. :rocket:

Alex: Thanks — can you share the prefill params and TTLs we should use?

Taylor: Prefill plan (lightweight):
- warm requests: 2 per new tenant (mirrors 95th percentile usage)
- cache TTLs: static prompts = 4h, session-specific = 15m
- batch config: max_batch_size = 8, latency_budget = 120ms
- streaming: enabled by default, fallback = chunked response if KV cold

Jordan: SRE notes: if cold-start spike > 5 rps/instance, auto-fallback to smaller model pool and mark tenant as "partial-degraded" in telemetry. Also set circuit-breaker for 5% error rate over 2m.

Priya: Cost guardrail: start on quantized profile (gpt-small-q4) for first 24h. If p95 latency < 80ms and error <1% escalate to gpt-medium for quality checks.

Mateo: Renewal-risk heuristic (early warning): any tenant with >25% degraded responses in first 72h => CSM outreach + priority enablement play.

Taylor: Quick feedback capture (minimal friction): send a 3-question form via email/DM after first 24h: 1) onboarding ease (1-5) 2) latency OK? (yes/no) 3) anything broken? (short text). Save responses to Airtable and tag tenant row.

Taylor: Survey link (ops): https://airtable.com/shrAtlasFeedback

Alex: Prefill trigger example (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"atlas","prompts":["welcome v1","context seed"],"warm":2}'
```

Jordan: If you observe token inflation (unexpected long generations) — enable per-tenant rate-limit: user_per_min = 60 and set model_max_tokens = 512. Also add an alert rule: token_utilization > 120% for 5m -> page oncall.

Priya: Streaming safety: add heartbeat policy — if no token emitted in 300ms send keepalive chunk; client should render partial output and tolerate re-sends. This avoids perceived stalls.

Taylor: CSM handoff checklist (short):
- Prefill telemetry success > 95% (telemetry.prefill.success)
- Cache TTLs verified in tenant config
- Batch p95 latency < 120ms
- Feedback link sent and Airtable entry created
- Renewal-risk flag evaluated (72h window)

Mateo: I'll own the 48h mini-retro and follow-up actions. I'll post a summary in #customer-success and tag the owners. :white_check_mark:

Taylor: If anyone spots early churn signals on Atlas, DM me and I'll trigger the renewal playbook.

OpsBot: Reminder created by @OpsBot — 48h retro scheduled at 1800000000.

Alex: One more note — include a "graceful-degrade" message in client UX when we fallback to smaller model: short rationale + CTA to contact support. Keeps customers calm. :+1:
